findings.evidence: Fresh-root recheck is under flock and `owned` prevents the losing controller from writing failure data to the winner. Tests use real child subprocesses and record/reap direct child PIDs on normal, watchdog and controller SIGTERM paths; pidfd is used where available. Source documents explicitly limit this to one direct child, sampled RSS/output/wall watchers plus rlimits, cooperating local lock, ephemeral in-process acknowledgment, and no SIGKILL/power-loss/daemon escape guarantee.
findings.limit: These controls are not cgroup/process-tree containment or hostile-writer isolation. Actual caps are source-configured, not measured under an actual graph.
